The AI assistant
built to stay secure.

OpenLobster is a personal, self-hosted AI agent. It runs as a single Go binary, connects to the channels your users already use, and ships with authentication on by default — unlike the project it replaces.

How it works

👤

Remember that I prefer dark mode in all my applications

🦞

Got it! I've noted your preference for dark mode. I'll apply this to any settings or interfaces I help configure for you. This will be stored in your user profile so I remember it across our conversations.

👤

Can you check my configuration?

🦞

Sure! I can see from your profile that you prefer dark mode. Let me check your current setup...

What changed

OpenClaw had security issues — CVEs, exposed instances, plaintext configs. OpenLobster addresses every flaw with a complete rewrite.

  • → Security by default — Auth enforced, secrets encrypted
  • → Graph memory — Neo4j instead of MEMORY.md file
  • → First-class multi-user — Per-user history and permissions
  • → Real task scheduler — Cron expressions, not heartbeat
  • → Full MCP — OAuth 2.1 with per-user matrix
  • → Go rewrite — Single binary, 200ms startup

Performance

200ms Startup time
30 MB RAM at idle
66 MB Binary size
0 Dependencies

The entire backend is rewritten in Go — no Node.js, no npm, no node_modules. A single static binary that runs on Raspberry Pi, VPS with 512MB, or $15 RISC-V devices.

Why it matters

OpenClaw shipped with authentication disabled by default. By February 2026, 40,000 exposed instances were indexed on Censys — 63% vulnerable to remote code execution.

OpenLobster OpenClaw
Auth by default✓ Enforced✗ Disabled
Secrets on disk✓ Encrypted✗ Plain YAML
Env var isolation✓ No leaks✗ Exposed to tools
Memory model✓ Graph (Neo4j)✗ MEMORY.md
Multi-user✓ Per-user history✗ Single session
Scheduler✓ Cron expressions✗ 30min heartbeat

Supported channels

The agent talks to users wherever they already are. Enable any combination in settings.

Telegram Discord Slack WhatsApp SMS (Twilio)

Each user gets their own conversation history, permissions, and memory context.

Tech stack

  • Backend Go + GraphQL (gqlgen)
  • Frontend SolidJS + Vite
  • Database SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL
  • Memory Neo4j or file (GML)
  • Secrets Encrypted file or OpenBao
  • AI providers OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, OpenRouter...
  • License GNU GPLv3

Quick start

# Build from source (Go 1.22+)
pnpm install
pnpm build --filter=@openlobster/backend

# Run
./dist/openlobster
# Dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8080

# Docker
docker run -p 8080:8080 \
  -e OPENLOBSTER_GRAPHQL_HOST=0.0.0.0 \
  -e OPENLOBSTER_GRAPHQL_AUTH_TOKEN=secret \
  ghcr.io/neirth/openlobster:latest
